name: geometry-space-mvp
description: 几何空间：数学题文字转图形理解工具

scripts.build:cf: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Remove-Item -Recurse -Force public -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force public | Out-Null; Copy-Item index.html,styles.css,app.js public/; Copy-Item cloudflare/_worker.js public/_worker.js"
scripts.deploy:cf: npm run build:cf && wrangler pages deploy public --project-name geometry-space-mvp --commit-dirty=true
